name: Camp Takajo
description_short: Camp Takajo is a summer camp for boys in Maine, near the Portland area. Parents use an online myTakajo account for forms, emailing their son, and viewing camp photos and news.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Info for Parents of Camp Boys - You're Part of Our Boy Camp Too

warnings: This is the parents' account/info page, not the dates and tuition page. It has no session dates, prices or ages. Check https://www.camptakajo.com/about/dates-tuition/ for those.
The page has an old heading, 'Our 2020 Camp Season'. Nothing on it is confirmed for the 2027 season.
The camp is called a sleepaway camp because the page mentions 'visiting day' and 'Bunk Life'. The page does not say this outright.
The state (Maine) comes from links to Visit Maine and Visit Portland and from the 207 area code. The page gives no address.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
